definitions.gloss: sugar confection; candy made primarily from sugar
definitions.explanation: Sweets or confections made with sugar as the main ingredient, such as rock candy, bonbons, fondant, or decorative sugar sculptures. Distinct from chocolate-based or rice-based confections.

examples.japanese: {砂糖菓子|さとうがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought sugar confections as a souvenir.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{砂糖菓子|さとうがし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: These sugar confections are beautiful to look at.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{砂糖菓子|さとうがし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦ショーケース→ショーケース：17995_shookeesu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Sugar confections, each handmade by a craftsman, are lined up in the display case.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧ (sugar) and ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (confection, sweets — voiced to がし through rendaku). Refers specifically to sweets where sugar is the primary ingredient and defining characteristic.

In Japanese confectionery tradition, {砂糖菓子|さとうがし} includes decorative items like ⟦{金平糖|こんぺいとう}→金平糖：14498_konpeitou⟧ (konpeito star-shaped sugar candy) and ⟦{飴|あめ}{細工|ざいく}→飴細工：17151_amezaiku⟧ (candy sculpting). Western-style sugar crafts such as fondant decorations also fall under this term.

The word is also used figuratively in the expression {砂糖菓子|さとうがし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような to mean overly sweet or saccharine, describing something unrealistically pleasant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂糖菓子|さとうがし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような: saccharine; overly sweet (figurative)
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砂糖菓子|さとうがし}: handmade sugar confections
- {砂糖菓子|さとうがし}{細工|ざいく}: sugar craft; decorative sugar work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧: hard candy — a specific type of sugar sweet
- ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧: Japanese confections — broader category of traditional sweets
- ⟦{洋菓子|ようがし}→洋菓子：04998_yougashi⟧: Western confections — broader category of Western-style sweets
- ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧: snacks; sweets — the most general term
